events.title: Flea Madness Trailer
events.summary: The official Flea Madness trailer is out! Get a look at the fast-paced firefights, team objectives, and rideable insects waiting for you in the game. If you like what you see, add Flea Madness to your Steam wishlist!

events.title: Flea Madness Is Back
events.summary: Hello, everyone!We’re excited to share that active development of Flea Madness has resumed. We’ve already put a lot of work into the game, and it has changed significantly from the versions you may have seen before. As you can see, Flea Madness is now a shooter, and we’re continuing to refine the experience ahead of release.We’re also planning an option to start a match with bots on your own, without needing to join an online server. events.title: We're back!!!
events.summary: As many of you know, we have had to freeze the development of Flea Madness due to war in our country. When Russia invaded Ukraine we needed time to adapt to a new reality. However, time is passing and we are now prepared to resume development of our game.
